name: When should I consider replacing an angle stop valve?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing an angle stop valve?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing an angle stop valve if it's leaking, corroded, difficult to turn, or if it fails to completely shut off the water flow to a fixture. Often, older plastic or multi-turn valves are prone to failure and can benefit from an upgrade to quarter-turn brass valves for better reliability. A key decision factor is the valve's age and material; plastic valves, especially, have a shorter lifespan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace an angle stop valve if it leaks, corrodes, is hard to turn, or doesn't shut off water completely. Older plastic valves often need replacing.
